svg.text: SignBridge-TR — Schedule of Deliverables (sprint-aligned Gantt chart)
Status as of 11 Nov 2026. SE 4910 by week and sprint; SE 4920 by month (sprint calendar to be confirmed). Generated from the same date list as Tables 1–5.
M6: advisor review before SoW submission (preliminary findings) — date, completion and scope unverified
Team initiation; Jira, Confluence and GitHub set-up
Project proposal v1.0 and literature review
Revised proposal v1.1 (R6) and list of changes
SoW: happy paths, scope of work, use cases, acceptance criteria
SoW: introduction, verification mapping, special requirements
SoW: schedule, economic, ethics, literature, references
Dataset exploration, AUTSL access, lexicon schema, MediaPipe check
Avatar approach research and playback pilot
Post-SoW feasibility work: coverage audit, landmarks, device benchmark
Ethics: drafts, BTTO consultation, committee application
Dataset audit and lexicon (MVP vocabulary + 300 signs)
Speech, LLM and TTS pipeline; back-end
Post-implementation report, demo video, poster, presentation
est. end of review — not an approval date
SE 4920 final submission / demo day: date to be confirmed (no marker)
* Sprints 4–6 follow the official course timeline and are not yet created in Jira. Arrows run from an intermediate output (circle) or from the end of a phase to the start of the next phase.

M1 Team initiation due 2 Oct 2026 M2 Proposal due 9 Oct 2026 M3 Revised proposal due 23 Oct 2026 M4 SoW due 13 Nov 2026 (planned submission) M5 Sprint 3 ends 15 Nov 2026 M7 Advisor review point 2, end of Jan 2027 (planned)

I1 MVP vocabulary and scenarios fixed I2 Model v2 and speech back-end ready for integration I3 Integrated MVP build frozen for audit (pre-tests also need G1) I4 Pre-test results and WCAG report available
